name.what: The name of the device group, shown in this list, in VPN rules that use the group and when binding limit profiles.
name.who: Operators and admins who write VPN rules or limits for a set of devices instead of one device at a time.
name.effect: Required, 1–100 characters, and unique: the server refuses a name another group already has. VPN rules refer to the group itself, so renaming does not break them. When a device is in several groups with limit profiles, the first group by name decides its profile, so a rename can change it; limits are re-applied on save.

description.what: A free note about the group, shown under its name in this list.
description.who: Teams that want to record what the group is for or who owns it.
description.effect: Optional. It is only shown in the panel and does not change any rule or limit.

network.what: Chooses which network's devices are listed below.
network.who: Needed to find devices, because the list shows one network at a time. A group can hold devices from several networks.
network.effect: Only changes the list; devices ticked in other networks stay selected. Nothing is saved until you press Save.

nodes.what: The devices that belong to this group. A device can be in several groups.
nodes.who: Needed before the group is useful: VPN rules and limit profiles that use the group apply to these devices.
nodes.effect: Saving replaces the whole member list and re-applies the VPN rules at once, so a device added or removed here gains or loses the access those rules give, and the group's limit profile.
